draft.flavor: A singular, white-hot spark that refuses to dissipate, turning the user's own heat into a permanent, unyielding engine of destruction.
draft.name: Ignition Core
draft.rationale: While siblings might merely release heat or cycle through patterns, this creature focuses its entire essence into a singular, overwhelming surge of elemental power that overrides all other limitations.

draft.flavor: The bucket cracks, but the skull beneath is unyielding, driving a dark shockwave through the very earth.
draft.name: Iron-Skull Impact
draft.rationale: While its kin might simply stumble or bite, this heirloom specimen utilizes its iron-reinforced skull to deliver a devastating dark-elemental strike upon itself, magnifying its own ferocity through the sheer force of its impact.

draft.flavor: The skull rings with a hollow, metallic resonance, absorbing the kinetic force of the blow to reinforce its own structural integrity.
draft.name: Iron-Skull Impact
draft.rationale: While its siblings rely on standard zombie resilience, this heirloom specimen utilizes its reinforced cranium to convert incoming kinetic energy into a permanent increase in army-wide defense.

draft.flavor: The earth itself recoils from the weight of a thousand years of stagnation.
draft.name: Tectonic Impact
draft.rationale: As an heirloom of earth, the creature collapses into a localized seismic event upon its demise, turning its physical remains into a crushing weight that strikes all nearby enemies.

draft.flavor: The bucket cracks, spilling heavy silt that hardens into an impenetrable shell upon impact.
draft.name: Earthen Sunder
draft.rationale: While its kin might simply endure, this creature utilizes its earthen composition to generate a protective layer upon being struck, turning the very impact into a structural reinforcement.

draft.flavor: A dense, layered fortress of leafy greens that absorbs the impact of the world.
draft.name: Cabbagepult
draft.rationale: While its kin focus on the projectile or the rot, this specimen has grown thick, fibrous layers that convert the very weight of incoming strikes into structural integrity, ensuring it remains a steadfast anchor for the field.

draft.flavor: A sudden vacuum pulls the surrounding air through its spines, launching a pressurized gale of needles at the foe.
draft.name: Atmospheric Needle
draft.rationale: While siblings focus on simple volleys or spores, this variant utilizes atmospheric pressure to override standard combat metrics, turning its very structure into a high-precision pneumatic cannon.

draft.flavor: A sudden, violent discharge of earth-hardened spines that pierces through the very essence of the foe.
draft.name: Needle Burst
draft.rationale: Unlike its siblings who merely release spores or volley single shots, this creature channels an overflow of earth energy to focus its spines into a piercing, high-penetration strike.

draft.flavor: The ground itself rises to meet the blow, turning impact into stillness.
draft.name: Earthen Bastion
draft.rationale: While siblings focus on sporing or volleying, this individual hardens its very essence, increasing the army's defense and its own structural integrity through terrestrial density.

draft.flavor: A radiant constellation of jagged light that guides the way for those who follow.
draft.name: Luminous Spikes
draft.rationale: While its siblings focus on the physical puncture or the decay of the fallen, this cultivated variant uses its light to mend the spirit of its allies through the very points that would otherwise cause harm.

draft.flavor: A dark, cultivated husk that thrives on the friction of conflict.
draft.name: Caltropnut
draft.rationale: While its siblings merely exist as static hazards, this specimen converts the kinetic energy of an enemy's strike into a dark, spiked discharge that lashes back at the source.

draft.flavor: A dark, cultivated husk that thrives on the impact of its own defense.
draft.name: Caltropnut
draft.rationale: While its siblings might simply endure, this cultivated specimen converts the force of an impact into a dark, spiked retaliation.

draft.flavor: A sudden, freezing explosion that leaves nothing but a frozen void.
draft.name: Frostbite Detonation
draft.rationale: While its siblings focus on reanimating or harvesting, this specific specimen converts its own expiration into a massive elemental burst, ensuring its final act is one of pure, freezing destruction.

draft.flavor: When the cherry bomb shatters, it leaves behind a jagged, frozen core that refuses to melt.
draft.name: Frostbite Remnant
draft.rationale: While siblings might simply explode or bloom, this specimen creates a persistent, frozen shell that regenerates its own structural integrity through the very cold it releases.

draft.flavor: The air itself fractures into a thousand pink-tinted shards, shredding the very space between the shooter and the prey.
draft.name: Atmospheric Salvo
draft.rationale: While siblings might simply fire or reanimate, this unit saturates its own presence with elemental air, causing every shot to trigger a cascading overflow of projectiles that bypasses standard wind resistance.

draft.flavor: A burning obsession that refuses to cool, even as the flesh turns to ash.
draft.name: Cinder-Lust Embers
draft.rationale: While siblings merely reanimate or harvest, this heirloom specimen converts the heat of its own passion into a reactive layer of scorched skin that lashes back at those who dare touch its burning core.

draft.flavor: The cherry blossom petals ignite into white-hot embers, consuming the very essence of the fallen.
draft.name: Searing Bloom-Burst
draft.rationale: The action utilizes the cherry-bloom motif through an explosive release of fire, while the deathblast atom ensures the signature impact occurs upon the creature's demise, distinguishing it from the standard reanimation of its kin.

draft.flavor: As the cherry-flesh chars, the heat binds the soul to the embers, refusing to let the flame go cold.
draft.name: Cinder-Grafted Resurgence
draft.rationale: While siblings might simply reanimate or harvest, this heirloom specimen uses its burning essence to graft a permanent layer of heat-tempered vitality onto its own form, creating a self-sustaining cycle of scorched recovery.

draft.flavor: As the curtain rises, the earth itself begins to dance to a rhythm of decay.
draft.name: The Grand Performance
draft.rationale: While siblings focus on simple reanimation or growth, this individual orchestrates a final, scripted spectacle where its own demise triggers a calculated burst of destruction, ensuring the performance concludes with a definitive, unyielding strike.

draft.flavor: A brilliant pulse that synchronizes the light within its kin.
draft.name: Luminous Resonator
draft.rationale: While siblings focus on simple projectiles, this individual channels light to amplify the potency of the next strike for all allies.
